title: DOW-UAP-D096, Correspondence Relating to Project Blue Book, 1955
doc_notes: This document is a collection of correspondence and internal memoranda regarding the U.S. Air Force's handling of UFO reports and public inquiries between 1955 and 1956.

encounters.summary: A cigar-shaped silver object was observed by two teachers and 60 students, leaving behind a web-like substance ('angel's hair') that disintegrated upon touch and left a green residue on fingertips.
encounters.entity_behavior: motionless then traveled horizontally at high speed
encounters.location_name: Jerome Special School, Union County, Ohio
encounters.quote: cigar-shaped silver object traveling at terrific speed that wafted a blanket of 'angel's hair'

encounters.summary: A Mexican national claims to have seen a 12-foot diameter, 3-ton craft suspended 10 meters above Cerro Prieto, which he believes defies gravity.
encounters.quote: It was about 12 feet in diameter and the weight about 3 tons, which defies gravity.

encounters.summary: Scouts at Philmont Scout Ranch observed 8 UFOs performing eccentric maneuvers and returning a mathematical signal (Pi) sent by the scouts.
encounters.communication_content: The scouts sent the number Pi (3.1416) and the UFO returned the same signal.
encounters.location_name: Philmont Scout Ranch, Cimarron, New Mexico
encounters.quote: they sent the number Pi (3.1416). Needless to say they were all astounded when the UFO returned the same signal.

encounters.summary: Mrs. Edith B. Burton observed a silver, saucer-shaped object with a stack on top, moving from east to west at 8,000-10,000 feet.
encounters.entity_appearance: saucer-shaped, silver, stack on top and bottom
encounters.entity_behavior: passed from east to west without change in speed or altitude
encounters.quote: she saw an object, saucer in shape, both on top and bottom with something on top resembling a stack.
